sites.name: Fort Lyon Historic Military & Veterans Complex
sites.category: Military Fort / Veterans Hospital Historic Complex
overview: Fort Lyon is a historic military and institutional campus in Bent County, established as a U.S. Army post in the nineteenth century and later adapted for medical and veterans-related uses.
timeline: 1867 — Fort Lyon was established at this location as a U.S. Army post.
1906 — The site entered a new institutional era after its military use.
1932 — Development continued during the site's veterans and medical period.
moreHistory: National Park Service documentation identifies Fort Lyon as a historic district and confirms the site's long military and institutional history.
